evidenceUnit.independentUnit: one genuine consecutive TDCC sourceDate pair
evidenceUnit.rule: All cross-sectional rows from one TDCC vintage pair form one clustered episode. Repeated consumers or rereads of the same pair never increase N.

pairRequirements: both TDCC vintages carry immutable sourceDate, firstKnownAt/observedAt, source hash and parser version
full 17-grade integrity/reconciliation PASS at both vintages
date-effective TWSE/TPEx common-equity membership is certified for both boundaries
exact grade17 denominator equality for the primary cohort
no hard share-count/identity corporate action touches the pair
security identity continuity PASS; ETF/TDR/preferred/debt/non-common instruments excluded
outcome fields remain unopened until cohort hash is frozen
failClosed: missing firstKnownAt sufficient to establish executable outcome anchor

primaryFeature.name: SIGNED_TDCC_400PLUS_CONCENTRATION_DELTA
primaryFeature.rawDefinition: current chipConcentration minus prior chipConcentration, percentage points
primaryFeature.transform: within each admitted vintage pair, rank-transform admitted symbols to centered percentile in [-0.5,+0.5]; ties use average rank
primaryFeature.rationale: Holder identity and motive are unknown; promotion tests incremental predictiveness without pre-asserting bullish or bearish intent.

outcomeClock.decisionKnowledgeTime: later TDCC vintage firstKnownAt; never chipAsOfDate
outcomeClock.executableOpenRule: first official market open at or after firstKnownAt when firstKnownAt is before that session's 09:00 Asia/Taipei open; otherwise next valid session open
outcomeClock.primaryOutcome: 5-session forward total price return from executableOpenRule to the fifth subsequent valid session close
outcomeClock.primaryAdjustment: market/industry residual return under the locked baseline model
outcomeClock.suspensionRule: if execution open or horizon close is unavailable due to suspension, classify outcome UNKNOWN for that symbol/pair; do not carry stale prices or zero-return imputation

requiredFamilies: D06 institutional daily-flow state where same-generation PIT lineage is available
D06 leverage/shorting state where same-generation PIT lineage is available
passive/index-event state using shared primitive lineage
antiDoubleCount: shared institutional/passive/price-volume primitives may have many consumers but one receipt identity
TDCC concentration may not be relabeled institutional ownership, passive ownership, smart money or main-force ownership
missing control lineage is not imputed from outcomes; pair enters only the model tier whose controls are PIT-complete

primaryTest.method: pair-level cross-sectional partial rank/standardized coefficient, then aggregate across independent TDCC pairs
pairStatistic: partial coefficient on primary feature after locked M0 controls
pair-level Spearman correlation between primary feature and M0 residual outcome
aggregateInference: two-sided null H0: mean incremental ownership effect = 0
report M1/M2 as robustness without replacing failed M0
primaryTest.multipleTesting: Only SIGNED_TDCC_400PLUS_CONCENTRATION_DELTA × 5-session horizon × M0 is promotion-grade. All other features/horizons/models are prespecified sensitivity/robustness and cannot rescue a failed primary test.

l4Review.pairSignConsistency: at least 10 of 12 independent pairs share the sign of the pooled primary estimate
l4Review.inferentialGate: two-sided 95% interval for the mean pair-level primary effect excludes zero
l4Review.incrementalGate: adding the primary TDCC feature to M0 improves mean OOS rank information coefficient versus M0 alone and does not worsen it on the median pair
l4Review.robustnessGate: leave-one-pair-out pooled sign is unchanged in at least 10 of 12 omissions
l4Review.noRescueRule: secondary horizons/features, in-sample fits, best threshold, best quintile cut or posthoc regime slicing cannot rescue a failed primary gate

futurePairPolicy.reason: avoid treating already-observed pre-freeze weekly vintages as new prospective promotion evidence

alwaysReport: admitted and excluded symbol counts with reasons
all prespecified horizon results including failures
neverReportAsProof: pooled symbol-level p-value that ignores vintage clustering
same-vintage repeated scans as independent dates

maturityDecision.rationale: The final clean cohort and prospective validation protocol are frozen, but no post-freeze OOS/Shadow outcome evidence exists yet.

exactNext: For each genuinely new TDCC weekly sourceDate after 2026-10-08, build the next pair under the same event/denominator/identity/security-type gates, freeze cohort/hash before outcomes, then append Shadow outcomes exactly under this preregistration. At 8 pairs report interim only; at >=12 independent pairs and >=2 regimes run the locked L4 review.
